audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose treated Defiant Dance as damage mitigation against Anivia.
audit.why: Irelia W reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge; every Anivia ability in the kit is magic. The lane is decided by Crystallize denying Bladesurge, not by tanking.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10 (49.14% over 814 games). Your losses come from an ice wall between you and the reset, not from a lost damage race.
sources: enemyKit W text and terrain flag

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] credit Anivia's level 6 spike to Rebirth. Rebirth is a passive that exists from level 1.
audit.why: enemyKit P has no level gate. The real level 6 change is Glacial Storm (4/3/2 recast, 750 range), because Frostbite doubles on a target 'damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm' — the storm arms her double without Flash Frost.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Glacial Storm arming Frostbite independently. First item = ability haste making Crystallize's flat 17s come up more often.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were never stated: Crystallize is an impassable wall that blocks Bladesurge, and Frostbite's double is armed by Flash Frost OR a fully formed Glacial Storm.
audit.why: enemyKit W: 'an impassable wall of ice to block all movement', terrain flag 'blocks paths and dashes'. ownerKit Q is a dash. enemyKit E text names both arming conditions.
audit.corrected: Dash before Crystallize, never after. Sidestepping Flash Frost halves Frostbite, but standing in Glacial Storm gives the double back for free.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and the packet notes zero sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7 at 1075 range, Crystallize a flat 17s, Frostbite a flat 4s, Glacial Storm 4/3/2.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, plus 'wait for X before you Y' lines in dosFull and ahead.

edits.before: - Anivia Flash Frost (Stun): matchup-defining — The slow-moving stun starts every Anivia kill — sidestep it and her E never doubles. Check it before every step-up. - W Defiant Dance is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Flash Frost: 11s at rank 1, 1075 range — sidestep it and Frostbite loses its double. - Crystallize: 17s flat, and the wall blocks Bladesurge outright. - Frostbite: 4s, so she gets one every trade. - Glacial Storm also arms the double, so do not stand in it.

edits.before: W joins: the channel shreds incoming damage — hold it for his trade spell, not his autos.
edits.after: W joins, but it cuts physical damage only — against Flash Frost you dodge, you do not tank.
